desks.name: Market
desks.style: Shortest posted 1X2 and total

desks.name: Form
desks.style: Points from the last five settled matches

desks.name: Attack
desks.style: Expected goals from recent scoring and conceding

desks.name: Shield
desks.style: Fewest goals conceded in the last five

desks.name: Pulse
desks.style: Points from the last three only

desks.name: Poisson
desks.style: Independent Poisson on recent attack and defence

desks.name: Elo
desks.style: Points plus goal difference, with a home nudge

desks.name: Fortress
desks.style: Home unless the away price is genuinely short

desks.name: Road
desks.style: Away sides that keep pace with home form

desks.name: Value
desks.style: Fades a heavy favourite when form is close

desks.name: Contrarian
desks.style: Opposite of the posted favourite

desks.name: Line
desks.style: Attack lean plus the over/under versus the posted line

desks.name: Clean
desks.style: The side conceding less, and a BTTS lean

desks.name: Fire
desks.style: Higher recent goals-for, and overs when both attack

desks.name: Grit
desks.style: Wins plus draws over the last five

desks.name: Split
desks.style: Draw when the two prices sit on top of each other

desks.name: Banker
desks.style: Only posts when the favourite is 55% implied or shorter

desks.name: Blend
desks.style: Majority of Market, Form, and Attack

desks.name: Both
desks.style: Both-teams-to-score from recent scoring rates

desks.name: Run
desks.style: Win rate over the last five

desks.name: Bounce
desks.style: The worse recent form — a bounce play

desks.name: Cut
desks.style: Favourite only when implied is above 48%, else the draw
